meta.title: Arkansas County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Arkansas County's 2026 budget as filed with the state: one page (or two) per office, each with a single 2026 budget amount per line. We use each office's printed category totals and grand total. The document prints no fund totals and no all-funds total, so those are sums of the office pages.

nodes.name: County General Fund
nodes.note: No fund total printed; this is the sum of its departments. The document does not print the fund's name; 1000 is the County General fund in Arkansas's county chart of accounts.
